 Centre proposes stricter learner’s licence test, higher pass mark and expanded medical disclosures
 The draft driving licence rules propose raising the learner’s test pass mark from 60% to 75%, requiring more medical disclosures and waiving fees for changes to a licence holder’s personal details.
